name: orbital-trap-frequency
description: Closed form: sqrt(q k / m) / 2 pi, with the curvature and the mass to charge both declared in the model - arithmetic this engine has no part in. The two per cent tolerance is not slack for the physics, which is exact: it is room for the Fourier limit of the record, which at 160 oscillations puts the measurement 5.8e-4 away and reports an uncertainty of 1/T larger than that. What the tolerance cannot absorb is a frequency that depends on the orbit radius or the axial amplitude, which is what a field that was not exactly quadro-logarithmic would give.
